rule: Only claims with a named author and a link to the primary source. No unattributed forecasts.

items.claim: Global warming is more likely than not to reach 1.5 °C in the near term (2021–2040), even under the very low emissions scenario. In most scenarios, the midpoint of the first 20-year period that averages 1.5 °C falls in the first half of the 2030s.
items.who: IPCC — Climate Change 2023: Synthesis Report, Summary for Policymakers (B.1.1 and footnote 29)

items.claim: There is a 70% chance that the 5-year average warming for 2025–2029 will be more than 1.5 °C above pre-industrial levels.
items.who: World Meteorological Organization — WMO Global Annual to Decadal Climate Update (2025–2029)
